flag: Eight ships, the exact set linked from costacruises.com/fleet.html on 2026-10-21. Costa Firenze and Costa Venezia were removed: they sail for Carnival now and appear nowhere on Costa's fleet page. Costa Fortuna was removed for the same reason, no mention on the fleet page, so we do not call it a current Costa ship. The ship pages are JavaScript-rendered and serve no specifications in HTML, so year, tonnage, guests and class stay null for the whole roster.
